Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.

Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–1918
1 How important were technological innovations in changing warfare on the Western Front? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant to the course of the war was Russia’s defeat by late 1917? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–1945
How significant was political disorder in causing the weakness of the Weimar Republic in its early
years? Explain your answer. [40]
How important was violence in consolidating Hitler’s power after he became Chancellor in 1933?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–1941
How significant was the return of Lenin to Russia in March 1917 to the overthrow of the Provisional
Government? Explain your answer. [40]
How important was Trotsky in the establishment of Bolshevik rule to 1924? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE USA, 1919–1941
How significant was Prohibition as an aspect of intolerance in the 1920s? Explain your answer.
How important were the Alphabet Agencies? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the Yenan Soviet to the survival of the Chinese Communist Party? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant to the economic progress of China was the Great Leap Forward? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA c.1940–c.1994
How important were the Pass Laws in the apartheid system? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was President de Klerk to the ending of white minority rule? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How significant was the support of the United States of America to the establishment of the State
of Israel? Explain your answer. [40]
How important for the development of Arab-Israeli understanding were the Camp David meetings?
Explain your answer. [40]
